description: This is a C# test source file containing integration tests for the DELETE endpoint of catalog items in the public API, specifically testing scenarios for valid and invalid IDs with admin tokens.

classes.name: DeleteCatalogItemEndpointTest
classes.description: Test class for API endpoint DELETE /api/catalog-items/{id} in the CatalogItemEndpoints namespace.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessGivenValidIdAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that a valid delete request with an admin token returns a success response and status 'Deleted'.

methods.name: ReturnsNotFoundGivenInvalidIdAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Tests that deleting an invalid catalog item ID returns a 404 Not Found response.
